assumptions: Format checked against 42 real local sessions (structure only, no content read): line types user/assistant/attachment/system carry uuid+parentUuid; titles come from custom-title and ai-title lines; compaction uses a system compact_boundary line with logicalParentUuid.
Every line with a uuid is a chain link (attachment lines are parents of ~3400 messages). Branch = chain ending at the last user/assistant line in the file.
Known limit: parallel tool calls branch the chain, so a few tool_use lines (~26 of ~5000 in real data) are missed. No user or assistant text is lost.

Hidden: isMeta, isCompactSummary, isApiErrorMessage, isSidechain, tool_result, thinking, and user text starting with task-notification / local-command / system-reminder / bash output tags. Slash commands become [command: /name args].
First message is a system note with the working folder and git branch. Back-to-back assistant lines are joined into one message; a compaction note keeps turns apart.
Session id comes from sessionId (falls back to the file name). url is None.
